store.title: Global store
store.intro: Plugins, templates, components, users and settings that exist independently of profiles. Profiles pick from here, and instances will be able to browse the catalogue themselves.
store.usedByWarning: A change here reaches every profile that selected this entry:
store.usersHint: Accounts you want on every site — typically your own admin login.
store.noPlugins: No plugins in the store yet.
store.noTemplates: No templates in the store yet.
store.noComponents: No components in the store yet.
store.noUsers: No users in the store yet.
store.noSettings: No settings in the store yet.
store.templateDeleteConfirm: Remove this template from the store? Profiles lose the selection; it stays on the instances.
store.componentDeleteConfirm: Remove this component from the store? Profiles lose the selection; it stays on the instances.
store.settingIsSecretHint: For passwords and keys. The value is stored encrypted, never shown again, and only decrypted on its way to the instance.
store.settingDeleteConfirm: Remove this setting from the store? Profiles lose the selection; the value stays on the instances.
store.userDeleteConfirm: Remove this user from the store? Profiles lose the selection; accounts already rolled out stay on the instances.
store.pluginDeleteConfirm: Remove this plugin from the store? Profiles lose the selection; it stays on the instances.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.intro: A profile bundles configuration and rules. Instances that enroll with a profile's join code land in it automatically and receive its settings.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Really delete this profile? Assigned instances keep running but stop receiving configuration.
profiles.rotateConfirm: Issue a new join code? The old one stops working. Already connected instances are unaffected.
profiles.autoApproveHint: Off: an instance enrolling with this code waits for your approval and receives no configuration until then.
profiles.revisionHint: bumped on every change; instances pull the new configuration when it moves
profiles.payloadsHint: What this profile rolls out to its instances.
profiles.strategyHint: On: the instance is brought in line with the profile, local changes are overwritten. Off: only what is missing gets added.
profiles.usersAddOnly: Users are always add-only — existing accounts on the instance are never changed or deleted.
profiles.smtpHint: These SMTP details are written into the settings of every assigned instance.
profiles.otherSettingsHint: Any MatCMS setting key as a key/value pair.
profiles.usersHint: These accounts are created on the instances if they do not exist there yet. The password is hashed once here; the cloud never stores the plaintext.
profiles.pluginsHint: Plugin packages as produced by MatCMS under Plugins, Export. Same key = update on the instance.
profiles.pluginUploadHint: Passed through unchanged to the instances, which apply it via their own import.
profiles.componentsHint: Reusable blocks. The type is the identity — an existing type is updated on the instance.
profiles.componentFieldsHint: Same format as the MatCMS component editor, e.g. [{"id":"title","label":"Title","type":"text"}]
profiles.dbgOk: All placeholders map to a field.
profiles.templatePreviewHint: Sample page rendered with the values in this form
profiles.previewHeroText: A paragraph of body text, to judge font, line height and text colour.
profiles.pluginEditHint: The package is repacked on save — instances still receive exactly the ZIP their own importer expects. Bundled files are preserved untouched.
profiles.pluginCodeHint: Runs server-side on the instance. After rollout the plugin stays disabled there until somebody enables it.
profiles.pluginVersionHint: Raise it so instances pick the new build up — an unchanged version is skipped.
profiles.pluginDeleteConfirm: Remove this plugin from the profile? It stays on the instances.
profiles.globalIntro: What this profile rolls out from the global side. Store entries are taken by reference — change the entry in the store and every profile that ticked it gets the new version.
profiles.globalUsersHint: This cloud's users. Ticked accounts are created on the profile's instances.
profiles.useGlobalSmtp: Roll out the global SMTP settings
profiles.useGlobalSmtpHint: Takes the SMTP configuration from Settings, SMTP. The profile's own settings still override individual keys.
profiles.userPasswordHint: When editing, leaving this empty keeps the current password.
profiles.userDeleteConfirm: Remove this user from the profile? Accounts already rolled out stay on the instances.
profiles.settingKeyHint: A MatCMS setting key, e.g. site.canonicalUrl or analytics.ga4.
profiles.settingDeleteConfirm: Remove this setting from the profile? The value stays on the instances.
profiles.noUsers: No users in this profile yet.
profiles.noPlugins: No plugins in this profile yet.
profiles.noComponents: No components in this profile yet.
profiles.noTemplates: No templates in this profile yet.
profiles.componentTypeHint: Lowercase, hyphenated. This is the identity on the instance and should not change afterwards.
profiles.templateNameHint: This is the identity on the instance — a template of the same name is updated there.
profiles.tplParametersHint: JSON array [{ id, label, type, options, default }]. Types: text|select|color|number|bool. Referenced in CSS/layout as {{param:id}}.
profiles.tplMenuMapHint: An object { "slot": "menuKey" }. Resolves {{menu:slot}} in the layout against the instance's menus.
profiles.componentDeleteConfirm: Remove this component from the profile? It stays on the instances.
profiles.templatesHint: Designs rolled out to every assigned instance. The name is the identity. The quickest route is to build the template in MatCMS and import its JSON here.
profiles.templateDeleteConfirm: Remove this template from the profile? It stays on the instances.
profiles.templateImportHint: Paste the JSON from MatCMS under Templates, open a template, "Export as JSON". A template of the same name is overwritten.
profiles.activateTemplateHint: Leaving this empty means templates are rolled out but the instance decides which one is live. Switching the design of a running customer site should be a deliberate act.
profiles.tplLayoutHint: Only applied when it contains {{content}} — otherwise the default layout is used. The document head stays managed either way.
profiles.tplPartsHint: An object like { "post": "<html …>" }. Page types not listed use the built-in layout.
enroll.joinIntro: In MatCMS under Settings, Cloud enter the cloud URL and the join code. Works even when the instance is unreachable from outside.
enroll.noProfiles: There is no profile yet. Create one first:
enroll.adoptIntro: Enter an existing instance's URL and an administrator account from it. The cloud hands the link over directly — the instance has to be reachable once.
enroll.credentialsHint: The credentials are used for this one handshake only and are not stored.
instances.approvalTitle: This instance is waiting for approval
instances.approvalHint: It enrolled with a valid join code but receives no configuration until you approve it.
instances.noProfileHint: No profile assigned — nothing is rolled out.
login.heading: Sign in
error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The request could not be processed. Details are in the container log.
common.name: Name
settings.notificationsIntro: Applies to instances without a profile. Instances with one follow its rules.
settings.smtpIntro: Credentials of the outgoing mail server used for notifications.
settings.smtpTestHint: Uses the last saved credentials — save first.
settings.dockerConfigHint: Set through the environment variable, not here. Without a mounted socket every instance stays remote.
profiles.isDefaultHint: Catches instances that cannot be resolved to another profile. Exactly one profile is the default — setting it takes the flag off the current one.
instances.previewNoUrl: No site URL is recorded for this instance. Enter one under Settings, or wait for the instance to report it.
instances.previewGuessedHint: Derived from the local container port mapping. Only works when your browser runs on the Docker host — otherwise enter the real URL under Settings.
instances.previewHint: The page is loaded straight from the instance, so it has to be reachable from your browser. An empty frame means the site is unreachable or refuses embedding.
instances.urlHint: Used for the preview and the link to the site. The instance reports it itself once a public URL is configured there.
instances.rejectConfirm: Really reject this instance? Its heartbeats will be refused afterwards.
dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.releaseText: The cloud polls the registry centrally for every instance:
instances.title: Instances
instances.empty: No instance connected yet. Create one and paste its id and token into MatCMS.
instances.outdatedProtocolHint: The instance speaks an older protocol version than this cloud.
instances.pendingHint: Id and token have not been entered in MatCMS yet.
instances.remoteHint: runs on a different Docker host, updates are notify-only
instances.nameHint: Just a label for this overview. The instance reports its own site name on the first heartbeat.
instances.tokenOnce: The token is shown this one time only. Just its hash is stored.
instances.pairingHint: Enter these three values in MatCMS under Settings, Cloud. The instance then checks in by itself.
instances.updateConfirm: Really recreate the container from the new image? The site is briefly unavailable.
instances.updateRemote: This instance does not run on this Docker host. Run the update there:
instances.rotateConfirm: Issue a new token? The instance loses the connection until the new token is entered there.
instances.deleteConfirm: Really remove this instance? Its history is deleted with it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.canonicalUrlHint: Used for links in notification mails and for the pairing details. Empty = derived from the request.
settings.recipientsHint: Comma separated. Empty = every user of this cloud that has an e-mail address.
settings.notifyOffline: E-mail when an instance goes offline
settings.notifyUpdate: E-mail when a new MatCMS release is available
settings.autoUpdateLocalHint: Applies only to instances on this Docker host. The container is stopped, recreated and started; a failure rolls back to the old container.
settings.dockerHint: Through the mounted Docker socket the cloud recognises which instances run locally and can update those itself. Without a socket every instance stays remote.
settings.smtpSsl: Force SSL/TLS (port 465 always uses implicit SSL)
users.title: Users
users.emailHint: Used as the login and as the default notification recipient.
